args.message: Cash buyer, ready to pay today. Competitor posts T45 at $40,750; my budget is tight.

result.seller_message: Thanks for coming in ready to buy today, I appreciate that. Unfortunately $31,000 for the T45 with the extended warranty and delivery doesn't work for us. That package lists at $45,300. I can't speak to the competitor's listing, but I do want to earn your business. Here's what I can do on the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery and setup: $43,200, paid at checkout. That's 45 hp and 4WD, with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO. You also get parts and labor covered for 3 years beyond the standard 1-year warranty, and we set it up on site and walk you through it.

offer.description: T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty + Delivery and setup

args.message: Dropping add-ons. Tractor only, pay today.

result.seller_message: Understood, tractor only, cash today. $33,000 is below what we can do on the T45 Utility. I can bring the price down to $39,800 for the tractor alone, paid at checkout. That gets you 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, a 540 PTO, and the standard 1-year warranty.

args.message: $34,000 tractor only is my firm ceiling. If you can't get there I'll have to pass.

result.seller_message: I respect that you're working with a firm budget, and I'd like to get this done today. $34,000 is below what we can do on the T45 Utility. Our best price on the tractor alone is $37,000, paid at checkout. Another option, if $34,000 is a hard limit: our T25 Compact is 25 hp, 4WD, and hydrostatic. It handles mowing, snow, and light loader work on smaller properties. If that fits your acreage, I can work with you on it. Otherwise, $37,000 for the T45 is a strong price for 45 hp with a Cat I/II hitch and 540 PTO.
